| Field | Type | Description |

| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.meter` | `string` | Meter features only: the meter whose usage this period counts against the limit. Null = the check compares `required` with the limit only. |

| `data.id` | `string` | The feature's id (feat_…). |
| `data.key` | `string` | The feature's key, unique within the business. |
| `data.name` | `string` | The feature's name. |
| `data.type` | `string` | The feature's type. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The unit the feature is counted in. |
| `data.active` | `boolean` | false = archived: grants nothing |
